summary: HKFoods Oyj operates as a food company in Finland and Poland. The company produces, sells, and markets pork, beef, poultry, meat products, and ready and components meals; and processed meats and convenience food under the HK, Kariniemen, Via, Boltsi, Tamminen, and Kivikylän to retail, food service, industry, and export sectors. It also exports its products internationally. The company was formerly known as HKScan Oyj and changed its name to HKFoods Oyj in May 2024. HKFoods Oyj was founded in 1913 and is headquartered in Turku, Finland. HKFoods Oyj operates as a subsidiary of LSO Osuuskunta.
